title: Blindsight may reflect lost prefrontal activity, not only lost V1

statements.text: Blindsight follows damage to primary visual cortex, but lesions have distant effects, and the lack of awareness in blindsight can go with reduced prefrontal activity even when task performance is controlled. A computational model explains blindsight by the effect of the sensory lesion on higher-order representations.

sources.quote: the lack of conscious awareness in blindsight could be associated with reduced activity in the prefrontal cortex
